evidence: A commenter highlighted the board's memory, TPU, Linux support, and purchase price.

evidence_sources.author: titzer
evidence_sources.excerpt: It's crazy what $5 can buy you in a microcontroller these days. Have a look at these Milk-V boards: https://milkv.io The duo has up to 256MB of memory, and a 1TOPS@INT8 TPU. They run Linux and are $5. I bought 5!

source_story_title: Running a 28.9M parameter LLM on an $8 microcontroller
